notes.title: Vicious Cycle has a release date!
notes.content: [p]Vicious Cycle finally has a release date, which is...[b]September 17th![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]I've been working on feverishly on new content for the final game for a while and I'm happy to finally show it all off. In fact, there's so much content that it could fill a shiny [b]new trailer![/b][/p][previewyoutube="of1hvz8QOw4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I can't wait to see people experience Vicious Cycle. I hope you're looking forward to it too![/p]

notes.title: Vicious Cycle is part of Indie Assemble! Also, new screenshots...
notes.content:
Indie assemble is a global steam event that's involved over 600 indie studios. I'm proud to count myself among them!

You can check out the festival here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble


I've been hard at work on the second exploration level of Vicious Cycle and thought I'd share some screenshots. 

The level centers around a long abandoned arcade, but you first have to venture into the basement:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/4ecf9ea068f3617cb41e705cdde7f013a383ba08.png[/img]

Inside you'll find a lot of arcade cabinets and amusements that are out of commission. If you look carefully you may find something else...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/1c6675091446d45e276024ffe08fc72e8f912f7e.png[/img]

You'll need to get the power back on, but some weirdo has decided to make the process more complicated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/ce80f2b8afac63487585ed3de70cbc7da67b1ea7.png[/img]

You may hear some rumbling as you travel through. All I'll say is, watch for the walls on the way out...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/ad0182355bc58134ca508910da2a8cb9639b9892.png[/img]

notes.title: Vicious Cycle is in the Feb 25 Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello Brave Travellers,

come check out the latest demo for Vicious Cycle! The more people trying the demo, the more it will help the game!

If you have any feedback about the demo, feel free to fill in this form after playing the game: https://forms.gle/bMg9mdccdwgPVa9j6


You can also access the form from the demo itself.

If you enjoy the demo, please consider giving the game a wishlist. Thanks for reading and I hope you find many fun games in this Next Fest!

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
The demo for Vicious Cycle has arrived!

You can now play try out the first bike section of the game followed by the first exploration section!

[h1]Can you survive the Bike Trail?[/h1]
The demo will give you a taste of the dangers you'll encounter in the full game while riding the Bike. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/bbfcb4911596655dcdfaa6aab1c9518fbb96b12e.gif[/img]

[h1]Uncover the mysteries of Ashford Stables![/h1]
Explore the abandoned Ashford Stables. You'll find twisted creatures, mysterious puzzles and remnants of those that used to live there...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/16145989c89582f3843c6f1496808b38fedc1866.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy the demo! If you have any feedback, you can give some through this form: https://forms.gle/6APy8QT4uBadyuNfA


Your feedback will be used to make the game the best it can be! Expect updates to the demo to improve the experience in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Vicious Cycle Beta Date announcement
notes.content:
The Vicious Cycle Beta will start at [b]9am GMT, Friday 7th February[/b] then finish at [b]9am GMT, Monday 10th February[/b]. You can sign up for the beta here: subscribepage.io/zKzdPH


Further instructions on how to participate will be provided when you sign up.

[h1]What's in the Beta?[/h1]

The Beta will be a short but spooky slice of gameplay. It will showcase two parts. The first will be a bike section with some supernatural creatures to escape:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/15d83f3b38e48e6729d3c08ceb4364f1eb1b8f55.gif[/img]

The second part will be a chance for you to explore the abandoned Ashford Stables:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413395/062975e1383b6dca5c7f554d440542b1deec7e12.gif[/img]

This will be used as a base for the demo which will release shortly after the beta. There will be a feedback form for you to send over once you've tried it out.

I'll use the feedback to polish up the game for its demo release, so I'll be counting on you not to hold back. Let's work together to create something real spooky!

notes.title: Limited time beta incoming!
notes.content:
Hello Brave Travellers!

There will be a limited time beta for Vicious Cycle where you’ll be able to try the game early and give feedback on the experience.

The only way to enter the beta is to sign up here: subscribepage.io/zKzdPH 

There is no exact date for it yet, but you’ll be the first to know if you sign up. You’ll also get monthly updates on Vicious Cycle before anywhere else!

Thanks!

notes.title: The cursed forest beckons…
notes.content:
Hello Brave Travellers!

My name is Rhys Thomas, the solo developer behind Brave Traveller Games. It’s taken some time, but I’m really happy to finally be able to share the game with you!

I’ll be sharing updates of the game here monthly. Expect posts about the game’s mechanics, setting and creatures over the coming months.

For more behind the scenes looks at the game and other daily updates, check out my BlueSky account: https://bsky.app/profile/bravetgames.bsky.social 

Finally, please check out the Brave Traveller Games publisher page and consider giving it a follow. It means you’ll be kept up to date with my latest games as they release: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/BTGames
